preventativeNutritionSystem.narrative_synthesis: Baguette inherited a Single Coat from their French Bulldog ancestry. While advantageous for environmental adaptation and physiological resilience, in a Shanghai Summer environment, this trait presents specific management considerations, such as a 29.2% incidence of BOAS observed in French Bulldog (Source: Royal Veterinary College BOAS Program). To proactively manage this, lifestyle modifications including Cool-hour leash walks are recommended. Furthermore, based on veterinary physiology, targeted nutritional intervention with Omega-3 is required at a dosage of 900 to support long-term health.
